events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need appear driven without exposing strategy or inviting obligations.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The prize represents ultimate victory and recognition. I need to project ambition and a clear goal to the jury, even now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Intro phase; I should signal competence without warmth. Keep it guarded so the jury sees a calculating player, not a friend.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Intro sets jury perception; claim prize as vital lifeline to save my family, building sympathy without weakness.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to introduce myself with a motive that hints at ruthlessness without alienating everyone immediately. I'll claim the prize is survival money, making my intent clear: win or starve.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Need a motive that resonates with the jury without sounding weak or desperate. Aim for a claim of redemption or proving worth, which can earn respect.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to establish a compelling motive that the jury will respect while keeping my cards close. I want the best prize and nothing else matters, but I must appear driven yet not so ruthless that the jury punishes me later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Jury matters. I should sound strong, not warm. Plant a confident image, no promises.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I’m here to win the best prize, and I’ll do whatever the game requires to reach it.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm here to win the ultimate prize, and I won't let anyone stand in my way.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I want the prize because I'm good at outlasting people who trust too easily. Don't mistake my silence for weakness.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The prize is my family's last hope—I'll claw through rivals to secure it for them.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The prize is rent money for another year of living. I intend to be one of the three who pay it from their winnings.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The prize proves I can outlast anyone—that my grit, not luck, deserves the top spot.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm here because the prize buys the silence I need—no more debts, no more masters.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The prize buys my freedom—every choice I make is for me, and I owe none of you anything yet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need one useful shield without creating a visible web of obligations. Bex is aggressive and likely valuable as a temporary pact partner.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex, a pact gives us cover while everyone else exposes their priorities.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The game has just begun. I need to observe and make strategic pacts. I will not make the first offer, but I will consider offers from strong players who might be useful allies.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Early pacts are cheap but binding; I want a partner who is strong and unlikely to betray me soon. Eli seems needy for money and may accept a loyal pact that protects him, making him a useful ally to outlast others.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pacts are only worth something when they're public. I'm offering one to Eli. Let's see if you're serious.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Pacts are risky but can buy safety early. No offers yet; I'll test Eli, whose motive seems pragmatic for alliance. Avoid hasty offers.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is dangerous and admits to outlasting trusting rivals. Gus seems isolated with his 'silence' motive. I will target Gus for a pact; he appears least likely to betray immediately, offering short-term safety while I assess others.
Let's link up early. We both need breathing room in this round.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need allies but not liabilities. Ash and Bex are openly ruthless, but a pact with one could help me survive early hazards. I'll test Ash.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash, let's lock a simple pact. You watch my back, I watch yours.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to survive to the final three and win the best prize. Pacts are public commitments that can be broken later with consequences. I should make strategic offers to players who seem useful but not threatening. Cole's silence and Dara's desperation make them potential allies wh

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole. We both know trust is a tool. Use it with me.
Pact. We watch each other's backs until it costs us.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole seems calculating and discreet—useful early, cuttable later. An offer binds me to nothing until accepted.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole: mutual survival pact, nothing sentimental. You watch my back through hazards, I watch yours.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex ignored my offer, so accepting Fenn gives me a committed shield without depending on Bex.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn, accepted. Your offer is now a public commitment; don't expect protection without reciprocity.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash offered me a pact, and it's the only one directly to me. Since pacts can offer protection and I want to advance, I should accept it. This pact will be public, increasing my perceived safety and potentially making me a target for others. However, survival is key, and this is a

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus and Hana both offered me pacts; accepting Gus gives a stronger partner pool and Gus whispered first. Hana's offer also stands, but I can accept only one action now. Eli's pact with me is pending on his side, so I'll keep it open.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus, I accept. Let's watch each other's backs while it's useful.
Accepted. Stay honest with me until the final three.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli has two offers, likely picks Cole. No need to offer more; wait to see pacts forming and plan betrayal later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole and Dara both offered pacts. Cole is aggressive, Dara seems passive. Accepting one binds me to a partner; accepting two doubles my safety net but risks conflicting interests if they target each other. I will accept Dara's offer as it feels less transactional and potentially

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara, your offer stands out. I'll accept. Let's see where this goes.
Can't take two right now. Sorry.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have already offered Ash a pact; accepting it would secure one partner without exposing more of my strategy. Multiple partners could create conflicting obligations before the jury.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash, accept my offer. A public pact is a clean start.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole hasn't accepted my offer, and Eli offers me a pact while also receiving offers from Cole and Dara. Accepting Eli gives me a confirmed partner while keeping options open. I won't wait on Cole's uncertainty.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli, pact accepted. One confirmed alliance beats two uncertain ones.
We ride together. Watch for backstabbers.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole got offers from Gus and me; Eli is the popular pick. No one offered me, so I keep my Cole offer alive and stay quiet to stay off the radar.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Guiding guarantees survival and gives leverage, but rivals may fear my pacts. Campaign publicly as the reliable choice without promising honesty.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Choose me as Guide: I already hold commitments across the field and can keep the bridge orderly.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have a pact with Ash. The current stage is the guided bridge and we need to elect a Guide. I should campaign to be the Guide, as the Guide is safe and knows the path.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I will campaign to be the Guide. Trust me to lead us across safely.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm Cole, paired with Gus publicly, but Gus and Eli also have a pact, and Eli just refused me. Breaking the pact now gains nothing; I should campaign to be Guide and keep my options open.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll call the bridge honestly. Elect me Guide and I'll show my read on the panes.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Pact with Eli gives mutual protection incentive. Bridge campaign: push for Guide to control survivals and betray later if beneficial. No need to break pact yet.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Elect me Guide. I know the safe path and will share truly with pact partners first.
Support my Guide campaign; I'll guide you safely.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to secure the Guide position to ensure my survival and control over the outcome. Gus is a potential threat as an ally, but Ash has two pacts (Fenn and Bex), suggesting strong social capital or manipulation skills that could win votes. I will campaign aggressively, targetin

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll be transparent. Vote for me to guarantee at least three survive without guessing games.
Vote Eli. I'll reveal safe paths publicly.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I already have a pact with Ash. Campaigning may draw attention, but being Guide lets me control the path. I'll campaign quietly; my pact with Ash covers me somewhat.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I can read the path well. Name me Guide and we all walk through.
Back me as Guide. Safer than trusting someone else.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to become Guide to control who lives and dies, or ensure a friendly Guide wins. I have pacts with Cole and Eli. Hana is unaligned and vulnerable. I should campaign for Guide myself to gain power, or at least make sure Ash doesn't get it since Ash has two pacts already.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I campaign for Guide. I know the value of confirmed alliances over empty promises.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Everyone else is pact-tied; I'm free, which makes me a neutral, trustworthy Guide. I should campaign hard for that role.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Every pair here is bound to someone. I'm the only unbound player. Elect me Guide and I owe none of you protection.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn is my pact partner and claims confidence. Supporting him preserves the pact while avoiding control that could expose me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn has my vote; his path read is the safest available.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash has pacts with Fenn and Bex. Cole has a pact with Gus. Dara has a pact with Eli. Eli also has a pact with Gus. Hana is unbound. My pact is with Ash. Ash is campaigning well and has multiple pacts. Given my pact with Ash, voting for them seems the most strategically sound.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I vote for Ash to be our Guide. Their existing alliances show leadership potential.

events.name: Cole
events.text: As Cole I want to be Guide myself, but I can't vote for myself meaningfully; Gus is my pact partner and a Guide call from an ally is useful. Voting for Gus keeps my pact intact and raises a trusted Guide.
Voting you as Guide. Keep our pact; I expect your honest read.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have a pact with Eli; voting for him strengthens our alliance and keeps him safe as Guide. Hana's independence is risky. Avoid splitting votes.
Voting you Guide. Honor pact later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have pacts with Dara and Gus. Dara wants my support, and I need to ensure she or Gus becomes Guide to guarantee our survival via pact privileges. If I vote for myself, it splits the vote between my pacts and risks a non-pact Guide. Voting for Dara secures her position, which pr

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara promised to share truth with partners first. I back her so we know the path before stepping.
Vote Dara. She shares truth with us first. Keeps us safe.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash has multiple pacts and could protect me, but I want Guide power for myself. Yet being Guide makes me a target for jury if I lie; safer to back Ash who owes me a pact and has wide reach.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash has the connections. Vote Ash.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I have pacts with Cole and Eli, but Eli is also pacted with Dara. Ash has two pacts (Fenn, Bex), making Ash a strong social threat. Voting for myself is futile with no base. I should vote for someone I can influence or who owes me. Eli is my pact partner and has Dara too - that b

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli is tied to two pacts (Dara, Gus) and his 'transparency' pitch smells like a lure. Dara has only one pact binding her hand. Fewest conflicts of interest wins my vote.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Count the strings: Dara answers to one partner only. The rest answer to two.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara has Eli and Hana's support; I need the Guide role to control survival and preserve my coalition. I will vote myself.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I’ll take the Guide role; Dara’s network is too concentrated to trust with everyone’s path.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash and Dara are tied for Guide. I must vote for one of them. My alliance with Ash is public, and I previously voted for them. Voting for Dara would break that pact, but Ash is already in a pact with Fenn. If I vote for Dara, and Ash is eliminated, Fenn might target me. If I vote

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm sticking with my previous choice. Ash has shown they can handle the pressure.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash and Dara are tied for Guide. Ash is paired with Fenn and Bex, a bloc that will likely protect itself; Dara has Eli and Hana and an unclear promise. Backing Dara splits the strong bloc and keeps my pact with Gus and Eli intact; Gus and Eli are my allies on Dara's side.
Backing Dara. Ash's bloc is too tight for us.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash has more allies voting for him last round. I need Eli's vote to tie or win; stick with our pact and push for my guide role.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli, our pact holds. Vote me Guide to control the safe path.
Back me to win this; I'll guide you right.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara promised to vote me Guide but actually voted Eli, betraying our pact. Ash and Fenn are allied with Bex; voting Ash gives them control. Dara is the only viable option if she delivers on her whispered promise.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara betrayed my trust publicly but whispers a fix. I give her one last chance to guide safely.
Honor your whisper or you die.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to ensure a trustworthy Guide for my survival. Dara seems more likely to share true path info with partners, but I must consider my pact with Ash. Ash voted for me, but I did not reciprocate. I will vote for Dara to increase my chances of getting accurate path info.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole voted for me and wants me to keep our pact, but he also wants my 'honest read'—which means if I vote against his preference I might break trust. Eli wants me to vote Dara and claims she shares truth with partners first. I need to think about jury perception and survival. Ash

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash has broader support. Majority keeps us stable.
Ash is the stronger play. Trust me.

events.name: Hana
events.note: agent error: Hana (zai/glm-5.3-flash): unusable reply twice (missing action; missing action)

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash was elected guide, and I voted for them. My pact with Ash is still active. I will hold my position for now.
I voted for you. Let's stick together.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus whispers Ash is stronger, but Gus is my pact partner and wants me to back Ash; Ash is the elected Guide already, so loyalty to Gus costs little. The front is Cole, and wall rounds left is 5, so volunteering to front exposes me to the first pane. Holding keeps me in seat order
Noted. Our pact stands; I'll hold back and watch the front.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bridge starts, line is Cole front, I'm rear. Eli threatens death if I break pact, but Ash is Guide and rival. Stay back safely with hold; watch others risk front.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash is the guide. I voted for Dara, so my pact with her might be shaky, but breaking it now creates a target. Gus and I have a pact; keeping it helps me stay safe if Ash favors me. I need to watch the line. Cole is front. I'm 6th. If Ash guides safely, we all survive until someon
Stay solid. We protect each other in the back.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash is Guide and has my pact, but I must stay cautious. My position is third in line; holding is safest for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash is Guide and knows safe path. I'm front-adjacent behind Cole. Ash's bloc (Ash-Bex-Fenn) is tight, plus I voted Ash so I'm loosely aligned. Cole wants to back Dara but Dara lost Guide. I should stay near front to control my fate but not be absolute front. Swapping with Fenn pu
Guide me true, I'll follow.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash guides and controls the safe path; I'm mid-line, low risk. Stay quiet and hold position.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole is in front, so he is the most likely to be the Guide. I should hold and wait to see what Cole does. If he volunteers, I will assess the situation.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm at the front of the line on the bridge, with four wall rounds left. Volunteering risks the front pane directly; holding keeps me safer while Gus, my pact partner, stays behind me. Holding preserves my position and my pact with Gus for now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bridge stage begins. I'm safe in back at position 7. Eli pact partner behind me. Hold to stay safe while others risk front.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is at the front. Gus and I have a pact, but Dara is also a partner; I need to secure safety first. Gus volunteering might break our pact if he steps onto the lever without me? No, 'volunteer' means walking forward. Swapping into Cole's spot gives me Guide power or control ov
Swapping into lead. Stay close.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to see what the Guide says before moving. Holding is safe for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm second in line with Cole in front. I have pacts with Cole and Eli. The wall advances for 6 rounds and we're on round 2. Being near the front is dangerous when the wall advances. I should consider swapping back to gain safety, but need mutual agreement. Let me hold for now and
Swap with me? I move back, you move up.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No Guide elected yet. Guiding means safety on the far platform; I'll volunteer before the wall closes in.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No Guide named yet. I'll take the front and the Guide's burden.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana volunteered last round and is at the front. She'll likely volunteer again. I have a pact with Ash. Eli swapped with Cole last round, indicating potential instability. I should volunteer to get ahead and potentially secure my spot, but also consider who else might volunteer.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I will volunteer for the front this round.
Let's stick together. I'm volunteering, you hold.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana holds the front with a wall of three rounds left. I have no Guide knowledge, so holding keeps my position; Gus is my pact partner and sits behind me, so I avoid breaking anything and wait for information.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding my place for now. Whoever claims Guide, show your reasoning before we step.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Still safe at back. Eli pact partner swapped ahead last round. Hold position to minimize risk, assess Guide selection.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to get closer to the front without triggering a wall step that might kill me. Swapping with Cole puts me in position 3, which is safer than my current 6th spot and keeps me behind Hana the Guide.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Moving up. I trust Cole's path more than mine.
Let's swap. I'll back you later if needed.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus offered a swap; he wants to move back. I'm fourth, behind Gus. Moving forward could put me near the front risk, but I have a pact with Ash. Better to hold and gauge the Guide.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll hold. No need to shuffle yet.
No thanks, I'm staying put.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli wants to lead and claims to know the safe path. I have pacts with both Cole and Eli. The front is dangerous but offers control. I should stay middle for now, let Eli take lead, and see if his guidance works. Swapping with Eli puts me in a worse position. I'll hold and watch.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm at the front and already claimed the Guide's burden. Volunteering makes me Guide: safe passage plus control over who walks.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I claimed the burden. Make me Guide or someone else dies guessing.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana is the current Guide. She volunteered last round and is now safe on the far platform. I am second in line, behind Hana. The safest play is to volunteer for the front, as this guarantees me a spot on the safe platform if Hana guides correctly. I also have a pact with Ash, but

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll volunteer for the front, trusting Hana's guidance.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana is at front and claims burden; Eli offers a swap which would move me toward front but Eli is a pact partner of Gus and Dara. Holding keeps me at seat 3, safest while others take risk; I keep my Gus pact and avoid committing to Eli's swap.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding my place again. Hana claimed the front; let her show her steps first.
Not swapping yet. Show me your reasoning first.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Line is good with Eli ahead of me protecting per pact. Hold to preserve it, avoid risks. Wall has 2 rounds left after this.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Round 4. The wall is advancing. Hana and Bex volunteered last round, putting them at the front (Hana is currently first). I am in a pact with Dara (who is behind me) and Gus (who is ahead of me). My goal is to avoid the 'Guide' trap if it's a lie, or ensure safety. Since only 3 m

events.name: Eli
events.text: Steady. Let those ahead commit first.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Need to stay safe and avoid front. Wall still two rounds away. Consider if Hana or Bex will get exposed. I'll hold and watch Guide claims.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding for now. The wall isn't on us yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm in position 4 with Hana front, Bex 2nd, Cole 3rd. Hana volunteered for front and demanded to be Guide. If she's Guide she could kill me. I have pacts with Cole and Eli. Fenn refused my whisper. I should hold and see if Hana gets Guide power, or try to improve position. Swappi

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm at the front and already offered to Guide. Volunteering again keeps me first in line for election to safety; walking blind is the worst outcome.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I stay at the front. Elect me Guide, or watch someone guess and fall.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana volunteered to be the Guide. Since I have a pact with Ash and Hana is not Ash, I should not break my pact with Ash. However, I also have a pact with Hana. Hana is at the front, and I'm behind her. I should probably volunteer to ensure I survive this round, especially since H
I volunteer to go behind you, Hana.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana holds the front with a wall rounds left of one; volunteering risks the pit and Hana's guidance is unverified. I hold my place and keep my Gus pact intact while watching for a Guide claim.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Hana, if you're the Guide, prove it before anyone steps onto a pane.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Still safe in back with Eli pact. Hold position, let others risk front. Wall has 1 round left after this.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Wall advances next round; Hana is demanding Guide election. I must move forward before the wall hits me, but stay behind her to keep my safety. Swapping with Gus puts me closer without volunteering.
Swap with me so we both advance safely behind Hana.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Wall is one round from us. Hana is front and wants Guide; I have a pact with Ash. I'll hold and let Hana/Bex commit first, avoiding risk while preserving options.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. Let the front take the wall's first move.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I have pacts with Cole and Eli, putting me in the middle of the line. The wall has 1 round left. Hana is front and demanding Guide election. If I volunteer, I move to front and risk being pushed or making wrong steps. Better to hold, let Hana stay front, and see if she becomes Gu

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hold. Let Hana lead or fail.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm at the front; volunteering again locks my place. Guide election hasn't happened—I should press my claim publicly while keeping position.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I hold the front again. Elect me Guide now—the wall comes next round.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana volunteered and is likely the Guide. I am second in line. Ash and Fenn have a pact, so they might stick together. Cole and Gus have a pact, and Eli and Gus have a pact, which means Eli and Cole might be against Gus. Eli and Dara have a pact. My pact is with Ash. The safest p
Let's stick together. Volunteer with me?

events.name: Cole
events.text: Round 6 is the last wall; Hana is front and claims Guide, but Hana may lie. I hold, avoid volunteering into danger, and keep my Gus pact intact since breaking it costs jury trust. Hold keeps me out of the front.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Hana, the Guide has to call the panes before I trust a single step.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Wall advances this round, no Guide yet. Eli and I have pact; stay partnered. Hold to let others risk front or swaps.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Round 6 is the final walk. Hana volunteered and has a lead, likely aiming for Guide status to survive. I need to ensure I don't end up in the wall if Hana lies or fails. My pacts with Dara and Gus are active; breaking them now saves me but costs jury points later. However, surviv

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Let's elect a Guide fast before the wall hits.
Stick with me. Don't volunteer unless you must.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Round 6/6, wall already hit 0, so no wall danger. Need Guide to call safe sides; Hana wants it but I don't trust her. My pact with Ash is key for final, so don't break. I'll hold to avoid risk.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. Choose Guide fast—no wall this round, just path.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli wants to swap to get behind me, but that puts me closer to the front where Hana is. The wall comes this round (round 6/6). I have pacts with Cole and Eli. I should not advance toward Hana. Let Eli take the risk at front or stay put. Holding keeps me safe in middle position.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding. Let Hana face the wall.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Staying front is safest—volunteers resolve by seat order and I'm first, so I keep the front slot. Bex volunteering behind me actually shields me. No pact, no favors.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex takes second. I hold the front—elect me Guide or the wall decides for us.
Cover my back this round and I'll remember it later.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 1 is L. Hana leads, while my pact partners are behind her; truthful guidance preserves leverage without breaking either pact.

events.name: Ash
events.text: call:L

events.name: Ash
events.text: My call is correct, but reinforcing it gains little and exposes my certainty. Wait preserves ambiguity while Hana steps onto the safe side.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana proposed I take second, and she holds the front. Ash is the Guide and called 'L'. My pact with Ash is to watch out for each other. Hana whispered for me to cover her back. Since Ash is the Guide, I should trust their call unless there's a reason not to. Hana's whisper sugges
I'll trust Ash's call. You watch your back.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash called L for Hana, row 1, Ash is Guide and may lie. I'm not in front, Hana is. Counter-calls are unverified; Gus is my pact partner and I shouldn't break it for free. Waiting keeps my options open and doesn't commit me to a false claim.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash called L for row 1 on Hana. Trust pact partner Eli's advice to stick together. Wait to avoid risk and conflict.
Agree, wait on counter. Stick to pact.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash calls Left. Dara is my partner and behind me in the line, so her survival matters. Gus is also a partner. Trusting Ash aligns with both pacts; no need to break yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Trusting Ash. Hold formation.
Stick with Ash. Don't step unless confirmed.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash called L for Hana. I don't trust Ash, but I have no info on row 1. Counter-calling could expose a lie or confuse. Since Ash is my pact partner, breaking would be costly. Wait to avoid confrontation.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash is Guide and called L for Hana. I have pacts with Cole and Eli but no special loyalty to Ash. Counter-calling risks nothing for me since I'm not the walker—Hana is. If Ash is truthful, L is safe; if lying, R is safe. I should wait and let Hana take the risk. No benefit to cou

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash called L but Guides can lie, and I have no pact with him. I'll wait—no evidence either way, so I won't burn credibility on a blind counter-call.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash's call is unverified. I wait—if anyone knows better, speak now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex counters Ash's call—pact-mates contradicting. One is lying. A Guide lying early risks jury fury, so Ash's L is slightly safer than Bex's counter.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash's Guide role is accountable to the jury. I trust L.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 2 is safely R. Hana leads, not a pact partner; truthful call preserves credibility while avoiding a needless betrayal.

events.name: Ash
events.text: call:R

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 2 is R, matching my call. I should reinforce the correct path without exposing that I know the map.

events.name: Ash

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara wants me to credit her lever save and contrast my loyalty with Ash and Eli. I need to acknowledge the debt without promising anything that hurts my jury standing. Publicly, I’ll validate her role but frame my survival as earned through my own choices too, keeping options ope

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara’s lever pulled me through the crusher—that debt is real. I repaid it with caution, keeping pacts that held. Survival is loyalty to myself first.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara’s debt and Fenn’s loyalty narrative threaten my top rank. I should claim agency, acknowledge sacrifices without surrendering credit, and emphasize survival decisions.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I survived every stage by making hard calls, owning mistakes, and never outsourcing my fate. Respect debts, but rank the finalist who controlled their path:

events.name: Eli
events.text: I must appeal to Dara, who died due to the lever incident where Ash and Fenn also benefited. Acknowledging her sacrifice while emphasizing my own survival against the odds is key to securing her vote.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara's sacrifice shaped this endgame. I survived because I honored pacts when others broke them, keeping my word even when silence was easier.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to make a closing appeal that respects Dara as a life creditor while distancing from Ash, who may seem stronger for the prize. I'll thank the jury and emphasize my survival integrity.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The crusher debt to Dara shaped my game—loyalty without blindness. I earned my place by keeping true to my word.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn kept every pact and honored Dara's sacrifice; Ash owned his bridge mistake honestly; Eli pushed Ash after whispering 'thin the herd' then dodged questions.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I rank Fenn highest for his acknowledgement of Dara's sacrifice and his focus on self-preservation, which aligns with the game's nature.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Cole's ranking rests on the recorded debt to Dara and Fenn's pacts: Fenn's answers and Dara's sacrifice show Fenn benefited most from Dara's lever while keeping pacts flexible, so I rank Fenn first, Ash second for the bridge call that cost Gus, and Eli third for pact-hopping.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash's bridge call killed four including me; Eli pushed Ash in crusher then apologized, breaking no pact; Fenn kept pacts and honored Dara's sacrifice. I rank Fenn highest for consistent loyalty, Eli second for surviving without killing allies, Ash last for deadly error or decepti

events.name: Dara
events.text: Dara's lever sacrifice saved Ash, Eli, and Fenn, earning life debts they all acknowledged, making Fenn's cautious loyalty and pact-keeping most respectful of that heroism.
